reproduction.method: Restored the published producer source for six owners temporarily with the final regression fixtures; finally restored each current source file. All thirteen failures are assertion mismatches, not fixture exceptions. The earlier preliminary probe included four invalid it.each fixture invocations; it is superseded by this corrected reproduction.

fixes: Canonical lineage parser checks both required algorithm fields and the signature length prefix; CMS SignerInfo checks the required signature OCTET STRING. Cryptographic verification remains unperformed.

Posture compares every present scheme, including empty signer sets; all-empty identity and v1 comparisons against empty schemes remain unknown. Corrected a test helper that had marked an absent v3 present in a v3.1 case.
ZIP tail owner bounds the full directory extent before classic or Zip64 end records; directory consumer rejects out-of-file extents instead of clamping.

One process-wide active APK scan and eight bounded waiters across provider instances, before filesystem reads; FIFO, queued cancellation reasons, double-release protection, failure capacity recovery and close/drain are covered.
Shared application service preserves the original pre-aborted signal reason without provider I/O.
